blurb.tm2003: The first TrackMania: Desert, Rally and Snow. Not sold anymore.
blurb.tmWii: TrackMania for Wii (Build to Race in North America). Plays in Dolphin with your own disc.
blurb.tmDs: TrackMania for Nintendo DS. Plays in melonDS with your own cartridge.
blurb.tmTurboDs: TrackMania Turbo for Nintendo DS. Plays in melonDS with your own cartridge.
console.title: Play with {emu}
console.downloadNote: From {host}, {size}. Checked by SHA-256 before it is unpacked. Stays in TM Horizon's data folder.
console.dumpIntro.wii: Copy your own TrackMania Wii or Build to Race disc into a file. The Dolphin guide shows every step.
console.dumpStep.wii.1: Put the disc into a Wii with the Homebrew Channel.
console.dumpStep.wii.2: Start CleanRip and rip the disc to a USB stick or SD card.
console.dumpStep.wii.3: Copy the .iso file to this PC.
console.dumpStep.wii.4: Optional: Dolphin can shrink it to .rvz (right-click > Convert File).
console.dumpIntro.ds: Copy your own cartridge into a .nds file. dumping.guide lists the ways for DS, DSi and 3DS.
console.dumpStep.ds.1: Pick a method on dumping.guide (for example GodMode9i on a DSi, GodMode9 on a 3DS).
console.dumpStep.ds.2: Dump the cartridge to the SD card.
console.dumpStep.ds.3: Copy the .nds file to this PC.
console.noRoms: TM Horizon never downloads or links games. Only use copies of games you own.
console.fileHint.wii: ISO, WBFS, RVZ, WIA, CISO or GCZ. TM Horizon reads the game ID to check it.
console.fileHint.ds: .nds file. TM Horizon reads the game code to check it.
console.ready: Ready. Play starts {emu} with the game.
console.notReady: Play works once the emulator and the game file are set.
console.resolutionTip: Sharper picture, needs a stronger graphics card. Set for each start; Dolphin's own settings stay.
console.texturesTip: Dolphin loads texture packs from Load\Textures\{id}. Put a pack there and switch this on.
console.online: Online: Nintendo's Wi-Fi service shut down in 2014. Single player and split screen work.
classic.noModsText: The first TrackMania runs on an older engine than Sunrise, ESWC and Original. The Horizon Client and the mod loaders are built for those, and the retail game carries StarForce copy protection, which TM Horizon does not touch. Play, folder and screenshots work.
where.title: Where do I get it?
where.tm-2003: Not sold anymore. You need the original CD (also with Power Up!). Install it, then TM Horizon finds it (or Library > Add game).
where.tm-wii: From your own TrackMania Wii or TrackMania: Build to Race disc, copied with your Wii. The steps are in the card on the left.
where.tm-ds: From your own TrackMania DS cartridge, copied to a .nds file. The steps are in the card on the left.
where.tm-turbo-ds: From your own TrackMania Turbo DS cartridge, copied to a .nds file. The steps are in the card on the left.
steamfix.title: Steam fix
steamfix.intro: The Steam version often cannot update itself. The fix makes it behave like the stand-alone version and installs Nadeo's last update.
steamfix.step1Text: Now: Distro={v}. A backup stays next to it (Nadeo.ini.horizon-backup).
steamfix.done1: Done. Undo puts the old file back.
steamfix.notFound: No Nadeo.ini in the game folder.
steamfix.step2Text: {size} from Nadeo's server {host}. Checked by SHA-256, then installed into the game folder. Windows may ask for admin rights.
steamfix.noUndoUpdate: The update has no undo here. Steam > Properties > Installed files > Verify brings back Steam's files.
suggest.title: Recommended for your game
suggest.steamfixText: Lets the Steam version update like the stand-alone one.
suggest.highlandsText: Community environment for United Forever, from ModDB.
suggest.horizonText: In-game menu, plugins and safe start.
highlands.step1Text: TM Horizon then watches your Downloads folder.
highlands.unverified: TM Horizon does not know this file yet. Compare the MD5 with the one on the ModDB download page first.
highlands.files.one: {n} file goes into the game folder.
highlands.files.other: {n} files go into the game folder.
highlands.done: TrackMania Highlands is installed. Undo is also in History.
united.title: Bought TrackMania United?
united.text: The free update to United Forever takes your United key. Install United Forever with the official setup and enter your key at the first start.
